places.name: Great Buddha Monastery (Chung Tai Thailand)
places.address: 91 Rim Klong Bangkapi, Soi Rongphayaban Praram 9, Rama 9 Road, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand
places.notes: Chung Tai Chan Monastery affiliate at 91 Rim Klong Bangkapi, Soi Rongphayaban Praram 9, Rama 9 Road, Huai Khwang, Bangkok. The monastery describes itself as a Thai-Chinese Mahayana Chan institution and lists monk-taught meditation and Dharma classes. Its current events page lists a weekly Friday repentance ceremony (19:00–20:30) and Diamond Sutra chanting Tuesday–Thursday (16:00–17:00); those are Buddhist services, not meditation sessions. Confirm class registration and access with reception.
